title: 한국의 언어적 금기
description: In Korea, there are certain words and expressions that are considered linguistic taboos.

lines.tr: In Korea, there are words and expressions that people avoid saying directly.
lines.comment:
The expression 직접적으로 means “directly” or “in a direct way”. 말하기 is the noun form of 말하다 (to speak), and 피하다 means “to avoid”. The structure -는 means that the preceding verb describes a noun.
Example: 저는 직접적으로 말하는 것을 피합니다. = I avoid speaking directly.
Example: 어려운 질문을 피하고 싶어요. = I want to avoid difficult questions.

lines.text: 어떤 경우에는 [특정] 단어의 [발음]이 [불길한|불길하다] 것을 [떠올리|떠올리다]게 하기 때문입니다.
lines.tr: In some cases, this is because the pronunciation of a particular word reminds people of something ominous.
lines.comment:
The expression 어떤 경우에는 means “in some cases”. 특정 means “particular” or “specific”. 떠올리게 하다 means “to make someone think of” or “to remind someone of”. 불길하다 describes something that seems ominous or unlucky.
Example: 이 노래는 어린 시절을 떠올리게 해요. = This song reminds me of my childhood.
Example: 불길한 느낌이 들어요. = I have an ominous feeling.

lines.text: 또 [다른|다르다] 경우에는 [죽음]이나 [질병]과 같은 주제에 대해 이야기하는 것이 사람들을 [불편하|불편하다]게 [만들|만들다]기 때문입니다.
lines.tr: In other cases, this is because talking about subjects such as death or illness makes people uncomfortable.
lines.comment:
다른 means “different” or “other”. The expression -와/과 같은 means “such as” or “like”. 불편하게 만들다 means “to make someone uncomfortable”. The structure -기 때문입니다 gives a reason and means “because”.
Example: 큰 소리가 사람들을 불편하게 만들어요. = Loud noises make people uncomfortable.
Example: 동물이나 식물과 같은 생물 = Living things such as animals and plants.

lines.tr: These kinds of expressions are called linguistic taboos.
lines.comment:
이러한 means “such” or “these kinds of” and describes a noun. The structure -라고 하다 means “to call something” or “to say that something is”. 언어적 means “linguistic” or “related to language”, while 금기 means “taboo” or “something forbidden”.
Example: 이것을 문화적 차이라고 합니다. = This is called a cultural difference.
Example: 이것은 사회적 금기입니다. = This is a social taboo.

lines.tr: One of the interesting examples is the number 4.
lines.comment:
흥미로운 is the noun-modifying form of 흥미롭다, meaning “interesting”. The expression -중 하나 means “one of” and is used when selecting one item from a group.
Example: 제가 좋아하는 책 중 하나입니다. = It is one of my favorite books.
Example: 가장 흥미로운 이야기 중 하나예요. = It is one of the most interesting stories.

lines.text: 한국의 [일부] [건물]에서는 엘리베이터에 4층이 [없|없다]거나 숫자 4 [대신] [알파벳 F]를 [사용하|사용하다]는 것을 볼 수 있습니다.
lines.tr: In some buildings in Korea, you can see that the fourth floor is missing from the elevator or that the letter F is used instead of the number 4.
lines.comment:
일부 means “some” or “a part of”. 대신 means “instead” or “in place of”. The structure -거나 connects alternatives and means “or”. 사용하다 means “to use”, and -는 것을 볼 수 있다 means “can see that something happens” or “can observe something”.
Example: 커피 대신 차를 마셔요. = I drink tea instead of coffee.
Example: 주말에는 영화를 보거나 책을 읽어요. = On weekends, I watch movies or read books.

The expression 왜 그럴까요? is a polite way to ask “Why is that?” or “Why does that happen?”. 그럴까요 comes from 그러다 (to be like that / to happen that way) and -ㄹ까요 expresses a question or invites the listener to think.
Example: 왜 그렇게 생각할까요? = Why do you think that is?
Example: 왜 그 사람이 화가 났을까요? = Why might that person be angry?

lines.text: 숫자 4를 [뜻하|뜻하다]는 [한자] '사(四)'의 한국어 발음이 죽음을 뜻하는 한자 '사(死)'의 발음과 같기 때문입니다.
lines.tr: This is because the Korean pronunciation of the Chinese character 사 (四), meaning the number 4, is the same as the pronunciation of 사 (死), the Chinese character meaning death.
lines.comment:
뜻하다 means “to mean” or “to signify”. The expression -는 means “that” or “which” when describing a noun. 발음 means “pronunciation”. The structure -와/과 같다 means “to be the same as”. 한자 refers to Chinese characters used in Korean writing.
Example: 이 단어는 사랑을 뜻합니다. = This word means love.
Example: 제 이름의 발음은 친구의 이름과 같아요. = The pronunciation of my name is the same as my friend's name.

lines.text: 이러한 발음의 [유사성] 때문에 일부 사람들은 숫자 4를 불길하게 [여깁|여기다]니다.
lines.tr: Because of this similarity in pronunciation, some people consider the number 4 unlucky.
lines.comment:
유사성 means “similarity” and is formed from 유사 (similarity) + 성 (a suffix expressing a characteristic or quality). 때문에 means “because of”. 여기다 means “to consider” or “to regard something as”. 불길하게 is the adverbial form of 불길하다.
Example: 사람들은 그를 좋은 선생님으로 여깁니다. = People consider him a good teacher.
Example: 이 두 단어는 발음의 유사성이 있습니다. = These two words have similarities in pronunciation.

lines.text: 따라서 한국이나 다른 [나라]를 [방문할|방문하다] [계획]이 있는 외국인들은 [자신]이 사용하는 표현에 [주의]를 [기울|기울이다]이고,
lines.tr: Therefore, foreigners who plan to visit Korea or other countries should pay attention to the expressions they use,
lines.comment:
따라서 means “therefore” or “accordingly”. The expression -(으)ㄹ 계획이 있다 means “to have a plan to do something”. 주의를 기울이다 means “to pay attention to” and is a common Korean expression. 자신 refers to oneself or oneself as the subject of an action.
Example: 한국을 방문할 계획이 있어요. = I plan to visit Korea.
Example: 운전에 주의를 기울이세요. = Pay attention to driving.

lines.text: [가장] [간단한|간단하다] 표현조차도 그 나라의 [문화]에 대한 흥미로운 [면]을 보여 줄 수 있다는 [점]을 [이해하|이해하다]는 것이 [중요합|중요하다]니다.
lines.tr: It is important to understand that even the simplest expressions can reveal interesting aspects of that country's culture.
lines.comment:
가장 means “the most”. The particle 조차도 means “even” and emphasizes something unexpected. -에 대한 means “about” or “regarding”. 면 means “aspect” or “side”. The structure -다는 점 means “the fact that”. 이해하다 means “to understand”, and 중요합니다 means “is important”.
Example: 작은 실수조차도 문제가 될 수 있어요. = Even a small mistake can become a problem.
Example: 건강이 중요하다는 것을 이해해야 합니다. = You must understand that health is important.
